dialogues.speaker: Scribbly Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Last night, I was passing by an alley near Mead-Boy, and I swear something bumped me on the back. But when I turned around, there was nothing there... I'm scared..."

dialogues.speaker: Childish Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Oh no... I heard Libuse talking about this... She said it's actually a cursed 'mark,' and if you get marked three times, you'll be doomed to wander those alleys forever..."

dialogues.speaker: Scribbly Handwriting
dialogues.text: "What!? That's awful! How do I get rid of these marks?"

dialogues.speaker: Childish Handwriting
dialogues.text: "It's easy. But first, answer this: A three-digit number, divided by its last digit, equals 37. What's the number?"

dialogues.speaker: Scribbly Handwriting
dialogues.text: "I consulted an engineer from Fontaine, and she said the answer is 185. What does this have to do with the three marks?"

dialogues.speaker: Neat Handwriting
dialogues.text: "That would be a little brat from the Conch Gang asking you to help him with his math homework... Don't ask me how I know..."
